#!/bin/bash
set -e

mkdir -p /tmp/claude/cfeb-callisto/callisto-origin-main /tmp/claude/cfeb-callisto/wisp-origin-main
OUT=/tmp/claude/cfeb-callisto
C=/Users/gabe/Projects/callisto
W=/Users/gabe/Projects/wisp

echo "=== Archiving repos ==="
git -C $C archive origin/main | tar -x -C $OUT/callisto-origin-main
git -C $W archive origin/main | tar -x -C $OUT/wisp-origin-main

echo "=== Generating logs ==="
git -C $C log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -80 origin/main > $OUT/callisto-log.txt 2>&1
git -C $C tag --sort=-creatordate --format='%(refname:short) %(creatordate:short)' > $OUT/callisto-tags.txt 2>&1
git -C $C log --stat main..origin/main > $OUT/callisto-new-commits.txt 2>&1
git -C $C log -p main..origin/main > $OUT/callisto-new-commits-patch.txt 2>&1
git -C $C diff callisto@0.21.0 origin/main --stat > $OUT/callisto-diff-since-0.21.txt 2>&1

echo "=== Wisp logs ==="
git -C $W log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -30 origin/main > $OUT/wisp-origin-log.txt 2>&1
git -C $W diff HEAD origin/main --stat > $OUT/wisp-head-vs-origin.txt 2>&1

echo "=== Install state ==="
{ which -a callisto; callisto --version; ls -la ~/.proto/tools/callisto 2>&1; ls -la ~/.proto/shims/callisto ~/.proto/bin/callisto ~/.cargo/bin/callisto 2>&1; proto list callisto 2>&1; proto plugin list 2>&1 | head -60; cat ~/.proto/.prototools 2>&1; cat ~/.prototools 2>&1; ls ~/.proto/plugins 2>&1; } > $OUT/install-state.txt 2>&1

echo "=== Projects listing ==="
ls -d /Users/gabe/Projects/* > $OUT/projects.txt 2>&1

echo "=== Other repo logs ==="
for r in michi monokl lumen; do
  git -C /Users/gabe/Projects/$r log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -5 origin/main > $OUT/$r-log.txt 2>&1
  git -C /Users/gabe/Projects/$r status --short | head -30 >> $OUT/$r-log.txt 2>&1
done

echo "=== Final listing ==="
ls -la $OUT $OUT/callisto-origin-main $OUT/wisp-origin-main
